Subject: Potential overlap: Fluxware / NovaStack accounts — quick sync?

Hi Neha,

Hope you’re well — we’re seeing some inbound outreach from a NovaStack AE to a set of shared accounts (PI: Pacific Retail, Helix Analytics and Arcadia Health). Fluxware is a long-time integration partner (we embed Redwood inference inside our orchestration product) and the reps are starting to log opportunities that look like co-sell. Before things escalate I wanted to confirm account ownership and make sure we don’t create duplicate quoting or contract terms.

Would you be available for a 20–30 minute sync this week to walk through ownership and the MAP? I can share our draft mutual action plan and the SOW we’ve been using with a couple of prospects.

Thanks — Samira

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Thanks for escalating, Neha. Short notes from my side after a quick look at the HubSpot records (link below):
- Pacific Retail (ACV ~ $320k) — currently listed under Field AE (NovaStack outreach seen last week) but Fluxware has an active POC.
- Helix Analytics (ACV forecast $90–120k) — primarily partner-led historically (Fluxware) but flagged as field motion for renewal.
- Arcadia Health (ACV ~ $45k) — partner-sourced, small pilot.

If we classify by ACV bands and contract stage, proposal:
- ACV >= $250k -> Field AE ownership but partner introduced deals get co-sell credits and require SSO + joint enterprise review.
- ACV 75–250k -> Default to partner-led unless AE has an existing signed LOE or active RFP in the last 30 days.
- ACV < $75k -> Partner-first (allow partners to own trials and initial POCs).

Operational asks:
1) Neha: capture a formal MAP from Fluxware (Samira already sent one) and attach to HubSpot deal record FLX-4821.
2) Jonas: can the Field AE team freeze outbound direct outreach for the three accounts until we land routing?
3) Marissa: I will draft a short clause for co-sell treatment to include in the MAP template.

On item 2 — Jonas, if you can confirm freeze by EOD that prevents new opportunity creation on these accounts that would be ideal.

Marissa Cole
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference

Team — quick closure note following today’s alignment call (recap and action items). Thanks Samira for walking through the MAP and SOW.

Decisions made:
- Routing rule (effective immediately): For the three impacted accounts (Pacific Retail, Helix Analytics, Arcadia Health) we will apply the ACV band rules below until Q4 review:
  * ACV >= $250k -> Field AE owns the primary opportunity. Partner (Fluxware) will be assigned as co-sell with joint quoting required (both signatures on the SOW).
  * ACV 75–250k -> Partner-led by default; if Field AE has an LOE or active RFP opened before 2027-08-01 then AE retains ownership.
  * ACV < $75k -> Partner-first and partner can close pilots without prior AE sign-off.

Action items and owners:
- Neha: upload Fluxware_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx and fluxware_sow_draft_v2.pdf to HubSpot deal FLX-4821 and attach SOW template to the MAP. (Due: 2027-08-06)
- Jonas: block opportunity creation in SF/HubSpot for Pacific Retail and Arcadia Health while we migrate records; notify AEs in the West region of the temporary freeze. (Due: 2027-08-06)
- Marissa: finalize co-sell clause language and add the clause to the partner MAP template; circulate to legal for quick review. (Due: 2027-08-09)

Samira: we’ll confirm once the HubSpot records are updated; once done, please proceed with standard pilot onboarding for the listed accounts.

Resolution link: https://hubspot.com/deal/FLX-4821

Marissa Cole
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
